title: Little athletics: sprinting
creator_credit: Shell Company of Australia, Australian Little Athletics Union and Tony Blane
brief_description: Skills and exercises needed for successful sprinting are explained and demonstrated in this film. These include techniques of body movement, relaxation and also the methods of starting and running the race. This film is interspersed with some shots of Australian women sprinters. Suitable for upper primary and lower secondary levels.
